units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שכתובה בל׳ יוני</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="J00206"><he>יונית</he></cite>) written in Greek (translation).

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>בכל ל׳</he> in any foreign tongue. Y. ib. I, 71ᵇ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:2:3">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:12">Esth. R. to I, 22</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00544"><he>זֶמֶר</he> I</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: evil talk, disrepute.—הוציא ל׳ על to spread evil talk against, to cast suspicion, discredit.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:4">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא תהא מוציא ל׳ על בניה</he> that you may not (by punishing her for private meeting with a man, v. <cite ref="J00270"><he>יִחוּד</he></cite>) cast suspicion on the legitimacy of her children.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:6">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תוציא ל׳ על וכ׳</he> do not discredit the decision by lots; a. fr.
